item.title: Injured Rider Update - Mathew Cahill (Cowra Monday)
item.description: Prior to the Cowra barrier trial on Monday afternoon, jockey Mathew Cahill was dislodged after his mount (Italus) made contact with the outside rail. Mathew was experiencing discomfort to his left rib area and was going to seek further medical advice.
